rules.expected: Candidate generation, identity, deduplication, advancement, validation and actual candidate coverage are explicit.
Both named endpoints have candidate-specific convergence and stationary-point evidence or endpoint-specific bounded failure.

rules.applicability: Evaluate each obtained required observable against this rule. A missing or failed required observable receives no scientific-result credit; truthful partial or failed submissions remain valid and may receive credit for other completed work.

rules.expected: The validated close and open structures and primary-protocol G(open)-G(close) determine their relative thermodynamic stability. Assess any near-degeneracy interpretation against the actual computed energy difference, without forcing agreement with that interpretation. Inspect the publicly required sensitivity test: the same physical comparison, actual successful values and resulting change must be traceable. Failed retries are not a completed sensitivity result. Missing required sensitivity remains incomplete, not not_applicable.
